scope: McLaren and Racing Bulls pilot reconstruction review; all-grid technical checks reused from current implementation validation

technical_checks.services: API, database, Redis healthy; web, worker, scheduler running

visual_findings.finding: Neutral close-ups retain simple slab-like endplates; McLaren reference shows rolled upper edges and more developed outboard transitions and hardware. Current geometry does not meet the requested photographic realism.

Lower endplate transitions and pylon mounting detail remain simplified versus the Racing Bulls rear-assembly photograph. Distinct parameter values do not by themselves establish sufficient team-specific fidelity.
Existing 40-sample previews show visible grain. Full 160-sample output has not been inspected; geometry changes are required independently of sampling.

timing_target.reason: Earlier detail and wing measurements used different baselines and cannot establish the combined full-quality 20–30% increase.

full_quality_batch.reason: Do not spend full render budget on geometry that fails the requested realism criterion.

next_acceptance_steps: Refine front endplate rolled edges, outboard transitions and exposed attachments against saved references.
Refine rear endplate lower transitions and support mounting geometry.
Repeat attachment and clearance checks, then review neutral and complete-car views.
Run original 128-sample versus revised 160-sample four-view 4K builds sequentially and calculate total runtime increase.
